publishedRecipe.name: One-Pot Turkey Taco Pasta with Bell Pepper, Shredded Lettuce & Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 green bell peppers
2 hearts romaine hearts
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the bell pepper.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies, turkey, taco seasoning, and salt. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ lb ground turkey
⅓ cup taco seasoning
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, cut lettuce crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.

When the turkey is done, add water, salsa, and pasta to the pot; stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until pasta is tender and the liquid is mostly absorbed, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cup water
2 cup salsa
10 oz macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is done, add cilantro, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide taco pasta between plates or bowls; top with shredded lettuce and yogurt. Enjoy!
